name: Blowgun Needle
summary: Ammunition for Blowguns; sold 50 at a time.
text: One piece of ammunition for Blowguns. A bundle of 50 costs 1 GP and weighs 1 lb.; it is usually kept in a Pouch, bought separately. Each attack with an Ammunition weapon uses one piece. After a fight, spending 1 minute lets you recover half of the pieces you used (round down); the rest are lost.
